STEP 1 - Scene: A cooked English-style breakfast on a tray: grilled/fried items, eggs, a muffin, orange juice and coffee. The meal is the items on the large white plate plus the muffin on the small plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Main plate is a disposable white plate, roughly 22 cm diameter (area ≈ 380 cm²). The muffin sits on a smaller side plate, roughly 16 cm (area ≈ 200 cm²). Juice and coffee are separate drinks, not counted in the food weight.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Grilled bacon/sausage-like meat piece (orange-brown, cured)
- Grilled tomato half
- Fried eggs (two)
- Grilled mushrooms (three or four)
- Muffin (on side plate)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of main plate, 380 cm²):
- Fried eggs: ~20% = 76 cm² (egg height ~1.2 cm)
- Grilled meat piece: ~10% = 38 cm² (height ~1.2 cm)
- Grilled tomato half: ~8% = 30 cm² (height ~1.5 cm)
- Mushrooms: ~10% = 38 cm² (height ~1.8 cm)
Food covers roughly 48% of the main plate.
Muffin: covers ~45% of the side plate (≈90 cm²), height ~5 cm.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Eggs: 76 × 1.2 ≈ 91 ml
- Meat: 38 × 1.2 ≈ 46 ml
- Tomato: 30 × 1.5 ≈ 45 ml
- Mushrooms: 38 × 1.8 ≈ 68 ml
- Muffin: 90 × 5 ≈ 450 ml (envelope including the paper case)

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Eggs: 91 × 0.95 ≈ 86 g
- Meat: 46 × 0.95 ≈ 44 g
- Tomato: 45 × 0.6 ≈ 27 g
- Mushrooms: 68 × 0.5 ≈ 34 g
- Muffin: 450 × 0.35 ≈ 150 g (muffin is airy but dense-ish; the paper case is excluded from the energy estimate)

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal/100 g):
- Fried egg: 196 kcal/100 g → 86 g = 169 kcal
- Cooked bacon/meat piece: 250 kcal/100 g → 44 g = 110 kcal
- Grilled tomato: 20 kcal/100 g → 27 g = 5 kcal
- Grilled mushrooms: 30 kcal/100 g → 34 g = 10 kcal
- Muffin (bran/blueberry style): 350 kcal/100 g → 150 g = 525 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total food ≈ 449 g, ≈ 819 kcal. For a full English-style breakfast with a muffin, this is plausible. The muffin dominates the energy; the cooked items are modest in weight. Estimates are rough given the single overhead view.
